mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.folder_id, p.title, p.author_id, u.username as author_name, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM subutai_posts p JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.folder_id, p.title, p.author_id, u.username as author_name, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM subutai_posts p JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.folder_id = #{folderId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.folder_id, p.title, p.author_id, u.username as author_name, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM subutai_posts p JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.id, p.folder_id, p.title, p.author_id, u.username as author_name, p.created_at, p.updated_at, b.id as block_id, b.post_id, b.block_type, b.content, b.sort_order FROM subutai_posts p JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN subutai_blocks b ON p.id = b.post_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY b.sort_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subutai_posts (folder_id, title, author_id) VALUES (#{folderId}, #{title}, #{authorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE subutai_posts SET title = #{title}, folder_id = #{folderId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE subutai_posts SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
